title: Mileage references and screen-based controls
summary: This topic combines low-mileage ownership comments with reactions to interior design and screen-based controls, so it is only loosely coherent.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise BMW's interior execution and overall ownership satisfaction, sometimes alongside early low-mileage impressions.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on very limited usable mileage due to problems and on screen-heavy controls being distracting and unsafe to adjust while driving.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly mention mileage or use ambiguous wording about work being done, with too little context to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes unrelated subjects, including mileage statements, general praise, interior design, washing quality, and screen-based controls.
Many sampled fragments are too short or context-free to determine sentiment reliably.
The provided examples are insufficient to explain all positive assignments, such as the fragment about a wash looking like a child had done it.
